title: Updating electoral enrolment details
summary: This page explains that if your name, residential address, or postal address has changed, you must update your details on the electoral rolls.
intro:
If details regarding your name, residential address or postal address have changed, you must update the various electoral rolls.

The Australian Electoral Commission (AEC) website provides an online form whereby you can update your details on all the electoral rolls:

If you're unable to update online, there are alternative methods of updating explained on the website.
